corrections.old: David Heacock explains how Filterbuy, his US air filter manufacturing business, reached more than $31 million in July as heat and wildfire smoke drove unexpected demand. The surge exposed weak inventory counts, order routing problems and a management gap after a regional leader resigned. He describes the operational changes that helped Filterbuy keep delivering and sustain sales momentum. His main lesson is to build and understand reliable operating systems before growth outstrips the ability to serve customers.
